title: Grateful Dead Live at Electric Theater on 1969-04-25

ai_review.summary: Top‑shelf Charlie Miller soundboard capture of a brief but spirited ’69 show with standout performances of Good Morning Little Schoolgirl, Doin' That Rag and an epic Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording is an excellent Charlie Miller soundboard transfer – crisp, clear and free of noticeable glitches. Musically the set is short and not overly adventurous, yet Pigpen shines on Schoolgirl and the band delivers solid jams on Doin' That Rag, Morning Dew and a marathon Lovelight; the only real blemish is Bobby's ill‑timed Yellow Dog joke.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is outstanding (soundboard, top‑shelf transfer) while the show is solid but modest in scope; weighted combination yields a rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller soundboard transfer praised as top‑shelf, crisp and clear with no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A concise ~1‑hour set that leans heavily on Pigpen vocals; while not a jam‑heavy marathon, the transitions are smooth and the performances are well‑played.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Plays slide on Hard to Handle and delivers strong lead work on Doin' That Rag; overall praised for his performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as being at his very best during the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers are highlighted as being at their very best, providing a solid rhythmic foundation.
